 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Copy the nonblank pattern block across divider-separated panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # Find full uniform divider rows/columns whose color differs from background.
    divr = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and grid[r][0] != bg]
    divc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != bg]
    # identify first pattern panel below/left of dividers
    rs = (divr[0]+1) if divr else 0
    re = divr[1] if len(divr)>1 else h
    cs = (divc[0]+1) if divc else 0
    ce = divc[1] if len(divc)>1 else w
    pat = [row[cs:ce] for row in grid[rs:re]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # repeat pattern into all panels (modulo block dimensions), keeping dividers
    row_bounds = [0] + [r for r in divr] + [h]
    col_bounds = [0] + [c for c in divc] + [w]
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        a,b=row_bounds[ri],row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            x,y=col_bounds[ci],col_bounds[ci+1]
            for r in range(a,b):
                for c in range(x,y):
                    out[r][c] = pat[(r-a)%len(pat)][(c-x)%len(pat[0])]
    return out
"
